+def _proxy_source(block: str, name: str, kind: str) -> Dict[str, str] | None:
+    # A nested GroupOperator contains its child's InstanceOutput, so a plain
+    # search returns the child's proxy when inspecting the enclosing group.
+    # Only the enclosing group's Inputs/Outputs entries are at brace depth 2:
+    # the GroupOperator itself plus its Inputs or Outputs table.
+    pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(?m)^[ \t]*%s\s*=\s*%s\s*\{\s*"
+        r"SourceOp\s*=\s*\"([^\"]+)\"\s*,\s*"
+        r"Source\s*=\s*\"([^\"]+)\""
+        % (re.escape(name), re.escape(kind))
+    )
+    for match in pattern.finditer(block):
+        depth = 0
+        in_string = False
+        escaped = False
+        for character in block[: match.start()]:
+            if in_string:
+                if escaped:
+                    escaped = False
+                elif character == "\\":
+                    escaped = True
+                elif character == '"':
+                    in_string = False
+                continue
+            if character == '"':
+                in_string = True
+            elif character == "{":
+                depth += 1
+            elif character == "}":
+                depth -= 1
+        if depth == 2:
+            return {"source_op": match.group(1), "source": match.group(2)}
+    return None
